answer: Identity is sedimentary: each epoch the ledger adds a layer to an account only if that account did work during the epoch, and layers cannot be backfilled. Weight is read off the strata like basalt columns, and a deep even column is slow to build, so k clones cannot compress k histories into one season. The horizon of an account is the oldest unbroken layer it can show, and a gap wider than two epochs resets the column. Reef-building is slow for everyone; a farm only shortcut is to start earlier, which it cannot buy.
